data.title: Core Scientific Is Quitting Bitcoin Mining as It Now Makes About 92% of Its Revenue Renting to AI Customers
data.description: Core Scientific has put a year-end date on abandoning the business that made its name, and its stock keeps sliding anyway. Behind the pivot sit one dominant tenant, a mountain of debt, and two milestones that could decide everything.
